views.name: hero
views.notes: wide frontal view; reference aspect checked against render_size (1.79:1)

views.name: detail
views.notes: top-left tile of a contact sheet; bands: ledge top face = projection (not a dimension), ledge front = geometry

rubric.name: composition
rubric.desc: major lines land where they do in the reference (within about 3 percent of frame height)

rubric.name: scale
rubric.desc: human-scale anchors hold; nothing reads larger than life

rubric.name: inventory
rubric.desc: every element visible in the reference exists in the render with the right count

rubric.name: lighting
rubric.desc: key direction, shaft angle, warmth and contrast match

rubric.name: materials
rubric.desc: value and hue families, reflectivity, trim placement

rubric.name: constraints
rubric.desc: nothing from the forbidden list is present

lighting_target._note: one entry per view; each entry has the boxes-JSON shape scripts/scratch_luminance.py reads with --boxes (normalised 0-1 coordinates). boxes = mean-luma value balance; features = one check per named lit event (a box alone can pass by coincidence)
